title: Bakka Bu'aa Muudame
intro: Namni baroota darbanii seenaa keessa tarkaanfachuuf qophaa'ee dhaabbatee jira. Yeroo karaan ifa hin taane fakkaatee shakkiin ummata keessa babal’ate, hojjetaan kun uffata qajeelfamaa akka fudhatu filatame. Ulfaatina ergama qulqulluu garba isaanii irra kaa’anii bakka warri kaan hordofuu irraa duubatti jedhanitti geggeessuuf gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfatan.
clues: Raajii tokko waliin akkan deemu filatamee ogummaa isaanii irraan baradhe
Waadaan Jiraachisaa keenyaa yeroo dhihaatu Taabota fuuldura dhaabadhee, namoonni shakkuu jalqaban arge
Hogganaan keenya osoo nuuf gaddee Rabbiin kadhachaa jiruu qarqara waan waadaa seenameef akkan dhaabbadhu na godhame
Ergama na dura nama biraaf kenname itti fufuuf muudame
Uummata gara bakka isaan geessutti akkan geggeessu aangoon waaqummaa naaf kennameera
Waan na dura jalqabame xumuruuf milkaa’eera, qajeelfama koo irrattis mirkaneessa ummanni argadhe

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
